Nina interview · section 2 of 9 · point 2.3 · round 1

Numbered 1 to 12, a "Start here" sticker, ticks when done

What Nina hit: it was not clear where to begin. Her strong recommendation: number the terms, add a "start here" arrow, lead people one by one, and show a tick on the ones done.

What changed (3 things)

  1. Every card shows its number 1 to 12 in the round badge, instead of an icon.
  2. The first card not yet done gets a red "Start here" sticker with an arrow, a red border, and a red number. After the first game it says "Next up".
  3. Done cards get a green tick and go grey. Free order stays: any card can still be tapped.
